data.alt: 1D Gaussian density profile centred at zero with sigma=1
data.caption: PlotImage widget. Renders a static
data.sourceCode:
import numpy as np
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

x = np.linspace(-4, 4, 200)
sigma = 1.0
y = np.exp(-(x ** 2) / (2 * sigma ** 2)) / (sigma * np.sqrt(2 * np.pi))

fig, ax = plt.subplots(figsize=(6, 4))
ax.plot(x, y, color="#1f77b4", linewidth=2, label="G(x; sigma=1)")
ax.set_title("1D Gauss, sigma=1")
ax.set_xlabel("x")
ax.set_ylabel("G(x)")
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
ax.legend(loc="upper right")
plt.tight_layout()
plt.savefig("gauss1d.png", dpi=110, bbox_inches="tight")
